card.name: Linking words before a medical term
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "as" in "also known as", "called", "such" and "well" in "as well as", just before a medical condition name or list. Also the middle of the word "syndromes".

modes.label: Naming phrases
modes.description: Words in phrases that introduce an alternate name or label for a condition.
modes.example: (DRESS), also known<< as>> multiorgan hypersensitivity, has been reported

modes.label: List introducers
modes.description: Linking words that lead into a list of symptoms or factors.
modes.example: your doctor will ask questions about your symptoms,<< such>> as:Do you feel short of breath

modes.label: Inside syndrome
modes.description: The middle of the word syndromes in a reference title.
modes.example: Hypoventilation and hyperventilation synd<<rom>>es. In: Mason RJ, Bro

card.writes: No clear link to the output; the promoted tokens are mixed multilingual fragments, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words like "also known as" that come right before a condition's name or a list of symptoms.
